guidance.statement: API business revenue to grow to 2x FY24 levels by FY30
API business EBITDA margin to exceed 15% by FY30
Expect growth momentum to further strengthen in FY27
EBITDA margins to strengthen from H2FY27 onwards post stabilisation of production at Montreal
Capex outlay in FY27 expected to be similar to FY26

We expect growth momentum to further strengthen in FY2027. In terms of EBITDA margin, it shall be the story of two halves. As production at CMO Montreal stabilizes, we expect EBITDA margin to start strengthening from H2 FY2027 onwards.
H2 margins would be in the range of 17% to 18%.
We expect that the business will grow in the sort of low double digits and we expect margins to remain in the 38% to 40% range.
We are committed to achieve net debt zero by 2030.
We expect to generate approximately $60 million to $80 million in revenue from Line 3 as we move into FY2027.
We expect to reach peak revenue in line 3 in one-and-a-half to two years earlier as projected and achieve an 80 million to 90 million specifically for line 3.
We expect that we will file MIBG's NDA in the second half of FY2027.
In FY2027, we are looking at a similar capex to FY2026.
We expect EBITDA margin to start strengthening from H2 FY2027 onwards as production at CMO Montreal stabilizes.
